dependent_to.description:
MLX is an array framework for machine learning on Apple silicon. MLX is
designed by machine learning researchers for machine learning
researchers. The framework is intended to be user-friendly, but still
efficient to train and deploy models. It provides familiar NumPy-like
APIs and supports composable function transformations for automatic
differentiation, automatic vectorization, and computation graph
optimization.
dependent_to.name: mlx

description:
Metal-cpp is a low-overhead C++ interface for Metal that helps you add
Metal functionality to graphics apps, games, and game engines that are
written in C++.
name: metal-cpp
